_comment: Winners of the Emu Cup, a community tournament. `photo` is the file in data_manual/emu_cup_photos/ (<season, 2 digits>-<name>.png, ASCII; not served; may not exist yet), `focus` = [x, y] of the face in the photo (fractions) for the round thumbnail made by scripts/build_emu_cup_thumbs.py. The newest season is the incumbent champion: scripts/build_victory_column_art.py (card face + caption) and web/js/cards.js (roll of honour next to the enlarged Victory Column) read this file.
